generations.exactPrompt: One uninterrupted 12-second take from a completely stationary tripod camera. FIRST and LAST have the same framing. Keep the entire reference dealer, her head and both hands fully in view at the original scale throughout the action. Preserve her identity, black blazer and ivory blouse. Keep the black shoe, bright chroma-green background AND tabletop fixed in the original screen positions; only the natural dealing movement changes. No zoom, pan, tilt, crop, close-up, reframing or camera movement. [0-1s] Hold the FIRST REDO pose. [1-4s] The hand touching the shoe draws ONE rigid plain-white poker-size card, about 63 by 88 millimeters, and carries it toward player seat 4: center, straight forward toward the viewer. [4-5s] Lay it flat exactly where the separate white card is visible in the LAST image: center about 50 percent image width from LEFT and 89 percent image height from TOP; this is the distinct seat-4 position entirely on the green tabletop. Preserve the complete card and hand inside the fixed original frame. [5-6s] Open all fingers and lift the entire EMPTY hand clear, leaving visible green separation between every fingertip and the card. [6-9s] Return that visibly EMPTY hand to the original REDO position beside the shoe without touching the dealt card again. [9-12s] Hold the LAST reference pose with the dealt card still motionless on the table. Never retrieve, lift, erase, cover or return the placed card. The shoe and its white front insert remain unchanged; every visible card surface stays plain unprinted white without ranks, suits, text, pictures or colored artwork. The tabletop and background remain the original flat bright chroma green with constant lighting. One complete deal, natural anatomy, fixed camera and full dealer visible throughout.

Keep C1 completely still at exactly that position, size and orientation for the whole take. [0-1s] Hold FIRST REDO. [7-10s] Return the visibly EMPTY hand to the original REDO position beside the shoe without touching the two cards again. [10-12s] Hold LAST REDO with both cards motionless and both contours visible through the final frame. Never retrieve, erase, dissolve, combine or return either dealt card.
